steps: Create git tag + branch checkpoint before each batch.
Emit deletion manifest (JSON) listing kept canonical + removed paths.
Archive removed skills to skills/archive/<batch-id>.tar.gz before commit.
batch_0_snapshot.rollback: git revert batch commit OR restore from skills/archive/<batch-id>.tar.gz and recommit.

batch_1_low_risk_exact_slug.description: Deduplicate exact-slug clusters where all members are identical after normalization.
batch_1_low_risk_exact_slug.execution_note: Start with pilot subset (200 clusters) to validate CI and tooling assumptions.

batch_2_remaining_exact_slug.description: Resolve remaining exact-slug clusters with minor textual drift by selecting canonical candidate and preserving changelog notes.

batch_3_operation_family_consolidation.description: Merge operation-family near duplicates into parameterized canonical skills.

batch_4_suffix_matrix_consolidation.description: Consolidate prefix/suffix matrix capabilities into canonical suffix skills where classification allows merge.
batch_4_suffix_matrix_consolidation.classification: merge into canonical skill or keep as distinct per cluster decision

batch_5_structure_hardening.description: Fix trigger clarity gaps and enforce required section contracts post-deduplication.
